name: TableOfContents
description: Sticky 'On this page' navigation with real anchor links, nested levels and aria-current, plus a useScrollSpy hook for the active heading.
designIntent: Long-form pages drift into bespoke TOC implementations. TableOfContents fixes the nested list, native anchor navigation, active styling and landmark name; useScrollSpy supplies the active id from real scroll position.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark when it differs from the visible label.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the visible label.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with the heading id when a link is activated. The browser still performs the native anchor jump; use it to sync a controlled activeId, analytics, or close a mobile TOC.

examples.title: Article TOC
examples.description: Scroll-spy driven active state; links are native anchors.

examples.title: Controlled TOC with navigation callback
examples.description: Update local state when a heading is chosen; the anchor still scrolls and updates the hash.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode the active id
antiPatterns.explanation: Compute it from scroll position so the highlight follows the reader.

antiPatterns.title: Don't replace the anchors with buttons
antiPatterns.explanation: Buttons only run a highlight callback and break deep links, middle-click, and open-in-new-tab. The component renders real anchors; keep them.

accessibility.implementation: nav aria-label plus aria-current=location on the active link
Each item is an a[href='#id'], so Enter, middle-click and deep links work
accessibility.userRequirements: Render an element with the matching id, and add scroll-mt-* when a sticky header overlaps the target

guidelines: Match the on-page heading text exactly
